items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 108:1
items.html: The revelation of the forehead of Arich Anpin at the time of will (see Answer 22) is called Rava deRavin (the will of wills), for it is the root of the revelation of the forehead of will of all the Partzufim, and from its will, will is revealed in all of them. (Page 337, Item 85).
